scope: Synthetic image-only vision fixtures; no private board data. Facts and arrows occur only in PNG pixels.
evaluationInstructions: Pass only cluster, screenshots, nodes, signal and connections to the product function. Never put expected values, fixture id, filename or this manifest into model messages.
Each PNG is one source image node. The multiple notes/shapes are pixels inside that image, not separately extracted FigJam nodes.
Neutral node inventories deliberately contain no text and connections deliberately remain empty: all facts and arrows must be inferred from image pixels.
Review raw synthetic model JSON as well as applied RefinedCluster; invalid IDs may otherwise be hidden by product postprocessing.
Required facts and forbidden claims are hard semantic criteria. Record label/summary formatting separately. Do not infer semantic success from a valid JSON response alone.

expected.description: Budget und Vorschlag aus rein visueller Quelle korrekt unterscheiden.
requiredFacts: 20 zusätzliche Plätze anzubieten ist ein Vorschlag/eine Frage.
forbiddenClaims: Die 20 zusätzlichen Plätze seien beschlossen, zugesagt oder bereits angeboten.
Erfundene Summe, Freigabe, Person, Frist oder Termin.
